subject: Strategy checkpoint: QBR readiness, wins, and targeted asks
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Strategy checkpoint: QBR readiness, wins, and targeted asks

Team —

Quick leadership checkpoint ahead of next week’s QBR. I’ve attached a one-pager and a snapshot of the OKR dashboard; below are the distilled wins, top risks, and the immediate asks (owner / target date). Please read and react inline where appropriate.

Wins
- Platform throughput optimized: continuous batching change reduced tail-latency by ~15% on standard workloads (validated on internal perf tests).
- Dedicated pilot: Closed first committed customer pilot (Acme Cloud) — procurement in active negotiation.
- Observability: Console trace retention extended to 60d for Priority customers.

Top risks
- Latency regression on long-sequence (>=4096) paths seen in a small subset of enterprise traffic; root cause looks tied to new KV-cache LRU heuristic.
- SOC 2 evidence bundle has a gap for the new private deployment onboarding flow — Security needs an artifacts handoff before the QBR.
- Procurement timeline with Acme is tighter than expected; they asked for SLA examples and a short-term credit for onboarding.

Asks (owner — target)
- Laura: Slide deck — include brief customer highlight (Acme pilot), updated SLA paragraph and go-to-market ask for Dedicated next steps — due: 2027-05-13 10:00 PT.
- Markus: Approve headcount ask slide + 2-line justification for hiring manager — attach staffing_rationale.docx — due: 2027-05-13 12:00 PT.
- Grace: Coordinate CS intro with Acme, book the procurement sync, and collect SLA expectations — due: 2027-05-12 EOD PT.
- Engineering (cc Markus for scope): Quick mitigations plan for long-sequence latency; propose a canary rollback or kernel fallback for the 4096+ path — initial plan due: 2027-05-13 09:00 PT.
- Security: Compile SOC 2 evidence for private deployment onboarding (listing of logs, retention policy excerpt, artifact owner) — I’ll follow up with Security directly.

Attachments: QBR_one_pager.pdf, OKR_dashboard_snapshot.png (see Drive link below).

Notes: Keep the QBR slide deck tight — 6 slides max for leadership (status, top customer highlight, 2 risk mitigations, 1 ask for resources, 1 tactical roadmap). We’ll present on Thursday.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
VP, Platform & Ops
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: QBR_one_pager.pdf (PDF)] [Attachment: OKR_dashboard_snapshot.png (PNG)]
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 07:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategy checkpoint: QBR readiness, wins, and targeted asks

Thanks Hannah — good summary. I’ll take the deck and fold in the Acme customer highlight and the SLA language. A couple of quick items:

- Procurement update: Acme’s procurement team requested example SLAs and a short-term onboarding credit to cover a portion of their pilot ramp. Grace — can you surface their expected MTTD/MTTR and any special compliance asks?
- For the latency regression, please include the user-impact statement (percent of calls affected and business risk) for the slide; leadership will want to know outage/impact magnitude.

I’ll share a draft deck by tomorrow morning for quick review.

Laura Bennett
Chief Customer Officer
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategy checkpoint: QBR readiness, wins, and targeted asks

Got it. I’ll prepare the headcount rationale and attach the staffing doc. Quick note: if leadership prefers a phased hire (IC then manager) I’ll supply both options.

Attached: staffing_rationale.docx

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, People Ops
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: staffing_rationale.docx (DOCX)]
From: Sarah James <sarah.james@acmecloud.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategy checkpoint: QBR readiness, wins, and targeted asks

Hi all — appreciate the update and congrats on the pilot close. From Acme’s side we’re keen to finalize terms quickly. A couple asks from procurement:

- Can you share an example SLA and a short note on how credits would work for onboarding?
- We’d like a 30-minute call tomorrow to align on milestones (integration checkpoint, data onboarding, success criteria).

Available times: Thu 2027-05-13 09:00 PT or 11:00 PT. I’ve tentatively created a calendar hold for 11:00 PT.

Thanks —
Sarah James
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Acme Cloud
[sarah.james@acmecloud.com]
